Jules (Finance): Heads-up 545 5 uploaded the pricing AB-test workbook. Two arms: Arm X = targeted per-token uplift + promo credits for devs; Arm Y = flat price + higher free tier usage cap. Need approvals for grandfathering window and whether to allow negotiated overrides for enterprise. Link: https://drive.redwood/pricing/abtest-1752000123
Connor (Sales): Quick skim. I prefer X for upsell motion but worried about churn in PLG. Do we have cohort impact?
Jules (Finance): Cohorts tab shows PLG devices and enterprise counts. High-level est: X nets +$38k MRR, Y nets +$9k MRR (month 1). See notes.
Maya (Ops): Operational note: our billing provider (Zuora) handles proration differently for metered vs flat subscriptions. We'll need a runbook for manual credits for ~120 legacy accounts.
billing-bot: Zuora integration status: proration supported for standard subscriptions; custom-metered plans flagged for manual adjustment. Doc: https://internal.redwood/billing/zuora-proration
Ravi (FinOps): Quick calc from the sheet:
```
Arm X: +$38,000 est MRR, uplift assumptions: 5% conversion on trial -> paid
Arm Y: +$9,000 est MRR, uplift assumptions: 2% conversion
Churn delta: X:+1.2pp, Y:+0.2pp
```
Sera (Legal): We'll need a concise amendment for customers in the grandfathered cohort, plus a 30-day notice requirement. Also flag: annual contracts must be excluded unless explicitly consented.
Connor (Sales): For big pipeline deals, sales override is a must. Can we model quota credit impact if we carve out deals?
Jules (Finance): Proposed policy: allow sales overrides for negotiated enterprise deals; mark them in CRM with a custom price tag so billing doesn't auto-migrate them. Leaves grandfathering: options are 60 days for standard, 180 days for channel partners. Thoughts?
Maya (Ops): 60/180 seems operationally manageable. We will need the per-customer flag in billing metadata to avoid auto-updating those.
Omar (EngOps): For rollout, suggest canaries: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring on billing failures and customer-facing errors. We will also put a circuit breaker to revert to old pricing within 30 minutes of >0.5% failure rate.
Ravi (FinOps): Also call out invoice sequencing issues: some customers will see multiple invoice updates during proration and may contact support. We should prep templated email and support playbook.
Sera (Legal): Approved with one tweak: the amendment must include an opt-out link and clear dates. I can draft language by Thursday EOD.
Connor (Sales): I approve Arm X with the 60/180 grandfathering split, pending legal wording and ops runbook.
Jules (Finance): Marking approved by Sales + Legal (pending ops runbook). Omar: can you own the canary schedule?
Omar (EngOps): I can. Will open rollout ticket and tag this thread. Plan to start canary next Tuesday at 09:00 PT.
Maya (Ops): I'll produce the billing runbook and the list of ~120 legacy accounts requiring manual credits. ETA: Friday COB.
Ravi (FinOps): I'll draft the customer notification template and add support SLAs.
Jules (Finance): Thanks everyone. If you hit any Zuora edge-cases, post them here so finance can triage manual adjustments. :rocket:
